name: CanonicalWireframe NodeTypes
purpose: Define NodeTypes and the Property ownership expectations of Entities using Canonical Contract Format 2.0.

model.ccf: Defines canonical Entity and Property structure.
model.nodetypes: Define what Property types an Entity of a given NodeType owns or is expected to own.
model.rulesets: Interpret canonical structure, Property semantics, relations, causality and flow.

rules: Entity.entity_type_ref resolves a NodeType by id.
NodeTypes do not define flow semantics.
NodeTypes do not define Link semantics.
NodeTypes do not define Event or Effect execution semantics.
NodeTypes do not define rendering, animation, geometry or layout.
Additional Properties may exist when their Rulesets resolve them.
Missing expected Properties make the Entity unready for the relevant Ruleset; they do not make the canonical Entity invalid.

semantics.required_property_types: Minimum local Property types expected for readiness.
semantics.owned_property_types: Property types structurally associated with this NodeType. This is not a closed allow-list.
semantics.property_cardinality: Optional readiness constraints for local Property counts.

readiness.ready: The Entity satisfies the NodeType requirements used by the active Ruleset evaluation.
readiness.unready: One or more expected NodeType Properties or cardinalities are unresolved or missing.
